title: UNR: Unified Notifiable RMA Library for HPC
problem: Modern parallel programming models lack completion detection schemes for Remote Memory Access operations. Prior work fails to address multi-NIC aggregation, hardware-software co-design, and usability across different interconnect technologies.
motivation: Remote Memory Access enables high-performance HPC applications, but the inability to detect remote completion limits adoption in complex multi-NIC environments.
method: UNR is a library that provides one unified interface for detecting when remote memory operations (data transfers between computers over a network) complete, regardless of what network hardware is being used. It works by gathering completion signals from multiple network adapters at once and coordinating between the software and the hardware. The library was tested by integrating it with PowerLLEL, a scientific application, and deploying it on four HPC systems that use different network technologies.
key_novelty: A unified library that tells programmers when remote memory transfers complete across different network types and multiple network adapters.
contributions: UNR library providing unified RMA completion notification mechanism
Multi-NIC aggregation and hardware-software co-design for RMA
Cross-platform deployment and validation on 4 HPC systems

metrics.speedup: 36% on 1728 nodes of Tianhe-Xingyi supercomputing system

limitations: Limitations not explicitly discussed; performance behavior on smaller systems and specific interconnect advantages unclear.
primary_theme: RMA completion notification for HPC systems
